The Krefeld Autumn Magic (Krefelder Herbstzauber) is an annual public fair held in October in the charming city of Krefeld. The name "Autumn Magic" alludes to the enchanting atmosphere presented to visitors during the fall season. Since its inception in 2015, the fair has been hosted on the historic grounds of the Krefeld Racecourse. This impressive location provides the perfect backdrop for the Autumn Magic, adding a touch of elegance and tradition to the event. The organization of the Krefeld Autumn Magic is managed by Reno Müller Veranstaltungen GmbH & Co. KG, a company renowned for its expertise in organizing high-caliber events. Notably, their specialization lies in organizing countryside events and autumn festivities at unique locations. The fair boasts a wide range of themes, spanning from culinary delights to fashion, art, jewelry, accessories, furniture, and decor. Carefully selected exhibitors from various sectors showcase their products and services, making the fair a magnet for enthusiasts of art, fashion, gastronomy, and much more. A special highlight of the event includes its diverse event program, walking acts, and live musical performances. For visitors arriving by car, ample parking is available at Sprödentalplatz. From there, they can avail themselves of the convenient shuttle service to the racecourse. Due to limited parking directly at the racecourse, it is strongly advised to utilize this service. In conclusion: The Krefeld Autumn Magic is more than just a fair – it's a genuine experience! The combination of a unique venue, top-notch exhibitors, and a varied program renders it an unforgettable event in the picturesque city of Krefeld.

The Mer & Vigne Annecy-le-Vieux fair is a unique showcase of French culinary culture. Held annually at the Espace Rencontre in the charming town of Annecy-le-Vieux, it invites visitors into a world of gastronomic discovery. The name—derived from the French words “Mer” (sea) and “Vigne” (vine)—is more than a title; it reflects the fair’s essence: the celebration of maritime delicacies paired with fine wine. Organized by the experienced Mer & Vigne SARL, the event has built a strong reputation through high-quality fairs dedicated to French gourmet culture. The timing in autumn is deliberate—when regional products reach their peak and the variety of fresh ingredients is at its richest. The fair showcases seafood specialties, artisanal products, and a wide selection of French wines. Carefully chosen delicacies from other European regions add a rich international dimension, making the event a meeting point for gourmets and professionals from both France and abroad. Yet Mer & Vigne is more than just a gourmet fair. It strengthens regional food craftsmanship, supports local producers, and highlights the culinary heritage of Savoy. Competitions and awards honor outstanding achievements in taste, craftsmanship, and innovation. Exhibitors represent sectors such as fishing, agriculture, winemaking, and artisanal food production. The audience includes professionals from gastronomy, trade, and manufacturing, as well as passionate food enthusiasts seeking unique experiences. As part of a nationwide event series, Mer & Vigne brings the richness and diversity of French culinary art to various regions, combining strong local ties with broad national appeal. The Espace Rencontre provides the perfect setting: modern facilities, excellent transport connections, and a location nestled between the Alps and Lake Annecy—an ideal backdrop for a celebration of the senses. Those looking to experience French cuisine in all its depth and excellence will find here a place where quality, authenticity, and passion come together.

Aux Vignobles! is an annual wine and gourmet fair that stands out for its combination of regional authenticity, professional expertise, and direct contact with producers. It caters to both industry professionals and private wine enthusiasts and takes place in several French cities, including Chartres, Angers, Biarritz, and Brest. In Chartres, the event is held at the Parc Expo l’Illiade – a well-connected exhibition center offering ideal conditions for tastings, conversations, and sales. The fair is organized by GL Events Exhibitions Opérations, a renowned event organizer based in Brest, known for many years of experience in staging high-quality consumer exhibitions in the fields of gastronomy and fine living. Formerly known as “Salon Vins & Gastronomie”, the event has been rebranded and conceptually refined to better reflect its focus and identity. At its heart are French wines from the country’s most renowned wine regions – including Bordeaux, Burgundy, Beaujolais, the Rhône Valley, Languedoc, Loire, Sud-Ouest, Provence, and Champagne. The fair serves as a platform for authentic wine experiences, offering visitors the opportunity to meet independent winemakers (“vignerons indépendants”), taste their products, and purchase directly on-site – with no middlemen, full traceability, and expert advice. This direct-to-consumer approach, known as “direct producteur”, is a key feature, enabling not only attractive pricing but also a personal connection to the people behind the wines. Special emphasis is placed on sustainable and certified cultivation methods. Organic wines and wines bearing the HVE (Haute Valeur Environnementale) certification demonstrate that quality and environmental responsibility can go hand in hand. The fair also places importance on wine tourism, which is gaining popularity. In addition to information about the wines, visitors are inspired with ideas for traveling to the producers’ regions and discovering the origins of the wines firsthand. Aux Vignobles! is much more than a traditional wine fair – it offers a multisensory experience. Discovering new grape varieties, comparing different terroirs, and engaging in personal exchanges with winemakers turn the visit into a unique journey of discovery. The experience is further enhanced by a selection of regional delicacies such as cheeses, cured meats, and other specialties that perfectly complement the wines. With its blend of high-quality offerings, expert guidance, direct access to producers, and a genuine French lifestyle atmosphere, “Aux Vignobles!” sets itself apart from conventional trade fairs. Appealing to both connoisseurs and newcomers, it impresses with regional diversity and transparency – and, with its clear focus on enjoyment, knowledge, and connection, has become an unmissable event for anyone wishing to experience French wine culture up close.

The Rohvolution is a significant fair that brings to the fore the theme of raw and healthy eating. It was founded by RohKöstlich GmbH and has been held annually since then. The abbreviation of the fair's name, 'Rohvolution' is a play on words, combining "raw food" and "revolution", thus underlining the revolutionary potential of a raw food lifestyle. The main topics covered include raw food preparation, devices and techniques for raw food preparation, and a broad spectrum of raw foods and drinks. Additionally, the fair features lectures and workshops about the latest innovations and trends in raw food. Visitors to the fair come from all walks of society, including health and fitness enthusiasts, families, and professionals from the food and nutrition industry.

Alba, a city in Piedmont in the northwest of Italy, is particularly renowned for its white truffle (Tartufo Bianco). This rare and highly prized truffle is found in the neighboring forests and hills of the region and is incredibly sought after in the culinary world. The surroundings of Alba provide optimal conditions for the growth of the white truffle, accounting for its top-notch quality and distinctive flavor. The white truffle from Alba stands out from other truffle varieties due to its intense aroma and refined taste. The significance of the white truffle to Alba is also evident in the annual Fiera Internazionale del Tartufo Bianco d'Alba. At this international truffle fair, held between October and November, the Palazzo Mostre e Congressi becomes a gathering place for gourmets from around the world every weekend, both on Saturdays and Sundays. Not only is the precious white truffle the centerpiece, but other regional delicacies like wines, cheeses, pasta, and baked goods are also showcased. Visitors have the opportunity to taste these specialties right on the spot. Show-cooking events provide inspiration, and attendees can participate hands-on in cooking workshops. During this season, the medieval Alba transforms into a vibrant hub of culinary and tourist activities. Those wishing to purchase the exquisite white truffle will find an ample selection in the specialty and delicatessen stores throughout the city. The fair is undoubtedly a highlight for food enthusiasts and celebrates the culinary heritage of Alba. It attracts foodies, chefs, and gourmets from all over the world who wish to taste, buy, and learn more about the truffle. The white truffle holds deep cultural and economic significance for Alba and its residents, shaping the culinary legacy of the region.

전시회명: Fiera Nazionale del Tartufo Bianco Pregiato
축제소개: The “Fiera Nazionale del Tartufo Bianco Pregiato” is a nationally significant culinary and cultural fair held annually since 1985 in the picturesque town of Sant’Agata Feltria, nestled in Italy’s Emilia-Romagna region. Every October, the Strada Provinciale Santagatese and the town’s historic center are transformed into a vibrant stage for flavors, traditions, and craftsmanship. Organized by the Comune di Sant’Agata Feltria, the fair is not merely a culinary event, but a deliberate tribute to the region’s cultural roots and natural richness. Amidst medieval architecture, gourmets, producers, chefs, farmers, travelers, and truffle enthusiasts gather for a celebration of all the senses. At the heart of the event is the prized white truffle – a delicacy foraged in the surrounding woodlands with the help of specially trained dogs. Available only seasonally, this aromatic tuber is much more than a regional specialty: it is a symbol of local identity and cultural heritage. Since 2021, the art of truffle hunting and harvesting has been recognized by UNESCO as intangible cultural heritage – a status brought to life at the fair through themed events, demonstrations, and informative exhibits. Yet, the Fiera Nazionale del Tartufo Bianco Pregiato goes far beyond showcasing truffles. It blends culinary excellence with traditional crafts, cultural exchange, and a diverse program of events. Visitors can expect a welcoming atmosphere shaped by regional cuisine, exhibitions, live music, guided tours, and hands-on workshops – all infused with the warm hospitality of the local community. A particular crowd favorite is the truffle dog competition, where humans and animals team up in a friendly contest to demonstrate their skills in finding the "white gold". Meanwhile, wine tours to local vineyards and inventive truffle-based dishes in the town’s restaurants offer indulgent experiences for food lovers. The fair attracts professionals from the culinary arts, agriculture, food production, hospitality, and retail sectors, as well as private visitors, travel groups, families, and gourmet travelers. Visiting the fair is not only a journey into the world of truffles but also an encounter with history and culture. Landmarks such as the Rocca Fregoso, the Angelo Mariani Theatre, ornate fountains, and historic monasteries create a striking backdrop with a unique atmosphere. The town is easily accessible by car or public transport and welcomes guests with autumnal colors, fragrant alleyways, and unmistakable charm. The Fiera Nazionale del Tartufo Bianco Pregiato is a celebration for all senses, a tribute to regional authenticity, and a shining example of how culinary excellence, sustainable values, and living traditions can come together in inspiring harmony.

Wine Prague is an international wine fair that has been held annually since its inception in 2015 in Prague. As a significant event in the wine industry calendar, this exhibition attracts numerous professionals and wine enthusiasts, primarily from Central and Eastern Europe. The name "Wine Prague" reflects the central theme of the fair – wine. It serves as an important meeting point for wine producers, consortia, retailers, and suppliers in the wine industry. Exhibitors showcase a wide range of products and services, including new varieties of wine, advanced cultivation methods, and innovative wine production technologies. The fair provides the perfect setting to gain a comprehensive understanding of Czech wine culture and to explore current industry trends. In addition, fascinating lectures and tastings are offered, which introduce attendees to the latest wines. A selection of regional delicacies and various cheeses complements the offerings. Highlights of the fair include not only wine tastings but also seminars and expert lectures. The organizer of the fair is YACHT, s.r.o., a company known for organizing high-quality and professionally relevant events. Wine Prague focuses on presenting quality wines and promoting wine as a cultural asset. In summary, Wine Prague offers a platform where professionals and wine enthusiasts can exchange ideas, network, and further their education. It is an indispensable event for anyone interested in the art and science of winemaking.

개최장소(베뉴): Palais des Congrés et des Expositions
축제소개: Once a year, the Palais des Congrès et des Expositions in Saint-Brieuc, in the heart of Brittany, transforms into a gathering place for true connoisseurs. Aux Vignobles! – formerly known as “Salon Vins & Gastronomie” – is a unique French fair dedicated to wine, gastronomy, and regional specialties. Held every autumn, the event attracts both professionals and private enthusiasts from across the country, all united by their passion for quality, taste, and authentic craftsmanship. The fair is organized by GL Events Exhibitions Opérations, based in Brest, a seasoned organizer of high-quality consumer exhibitions. With “Aux Vignobles!” they succeed in bringing together the diversity of France’s wine and culinary culture in one place – an ideal opportunity to discover and experience the richness of the country’s terroirs. The offerings range from wines from all major regions, such as Bordeaux, Burgundy, Provence, and the Loire Valley, to exquisite delicacies including cheese, charcuterie, chocolate, and foie gras. The selection is complemented by organic products and goods from sustainable agriculture, often certified with environmental labels such as HVE – a clear commitment to responsibility toward both the environment and consumers. A defining feature of the fair is the direct contact with producers. Visitors can taste on-site and purchase their discoveries immediately, often at particularly attractive prices. This closeness between producer and consumer lends authenticity to the event and fosters trust. For those who wish not only to taste but also to immerse themselves in the culture of wine, “Aux Vignobles!” offers inspiring insights into oenotourism – a blend of wine, culture, and the experience of landscapes. Thematic tours, such as a dedicated organic route, guide visitors through the diverse offerings and provide a structured way to explore the fair. Despite its national scope, each edition – including the one in Saint-Brieuc – retains its own identity with a regional focus. The fair thrives on local character, French hospitality, and the shared enthusiasm for fine flavors. With just one admission ticket valid for the entire duration, visitors are free to experience the event at their own pace – whether through a leisurely exploration or by returning to discover new favorites.

Expo Cerveza México is the leading trade fair in Mexico dedicated to craft and specialty beer. It offers a unique platform that brings together brewing expertise, entrepreneurship, innovation, and community. Over the years, the event has become a key reference point in both the Mexican and international beer scenes—appealing to hobby brewers, established producers, raw material suppliers, and distribution professionals alike. The event takes place at the centrally located World Trade Center (WTC) in Mexico City, known for its excellent accessibility and modern infrastructure. It is organized by Tradex Exposiciones, a seasoned company specializing in industry-focused trade shows. Expo Cerveza México is more than a product showcase; it is an active networking and knowledge-sharing forum. Its core themes include the production, commercialization, and marketing of craft and specialty beers. Exhibitors present every element of the brewing process—from high-quality raw materials such as malt, hops, and yeast, to state-of-the-art brewing systems, bottling lines, and labeling equipment. As such, the fair offers significant value to both startups entering the brewing sector and established breweries seeking to enhance their operations. A key feature of the event is the professional congress Mexicanos, Hagamos Cerveza ("Mexicans, Let’s Brew Beer"). This program combines hands-on workshops and presentations on essential brewing topics—such as water, yeast, hops, and malt—with business-oriented sessions on marketing, sales, legal frameworks, and management. The congress is complemented by the Beer Talks , which provide free access to presentations on the latest industry trends, product innovations, and technological advancements. A standout experience is offered by the tasting salon Salón de Catas , where guests can refine their sensory perception through guided tastings—an engaging opportunity for both industry professionals and beer enthusiasts. A major highlight for many breweries is the prestigious Copa Cerveza , a competition that recognizes outstanding beers across various categories and brewery sizes. Award-winning beers are clearly marked at exhibitor booths, turning the fair into a curated discovery journey for visitors. The Matchmaker program fosters targeted business connections among producers, suppliers, and distributors. It provides an ideal environment for B2B interactions in hospitality, retail, import/export, technical services, and related sectors. Expo Cerveza México is not part of an international trade fair series but rather a standalone national event with global appeal. It reflects the cultural richness of Mexico and sends a strong message of inclusion, respect, and community—regardless of origin, gender, or identity. The World Trade Center in Mexico City is easily accessible by public transportation, taxi, or car and offers modern exhibition spaces along with a range of amenities for both exhibitors and visitors. Expo Cerveza México is more than just a trade show—it is the vibrant heart of a growing beer culture that extends far beyond the borders of Mexico.

TERRAVINI is an annual celebration of culinary delight held in the heart of the Côte d’Azur, specifically at the Palais Nikaia in Nice. Dedicated to the finest products from land and sea, the event brings together food lovers, producers, and industry professionals in a distinctive and inviting atmosphere. The name TERRAVINI is derived from the Latin words terra (earth) and vini (wine), reflecting the core mission of the event: to honor regional culinary treasures born of soil, water, and vine. Organized by SAVIM EXPO SARL, TERRAVINI serves as a platform for authentic products and artisanal quality. It welcomes both private gourmets and trade visitors from the hospitality, fine food, and beverage industries. At its heart, the fair features premium wines, champagne, fine spirits, craft beers, regional produce, freshwater and seafood delicacies, exquisite chocolates, confectionery, and gourmet specialties. Many of these products are available for on-site tasting, both hot and cold. Exhibitors – including winemakers, distillers, chocolatiers, fishermen, bakers, and delicatessen producers – come primarily from France and offer genuine insights into their craft. TERRAVINI is far more than a sales exhibition. Tastings, product presentations, culinary competitions, and awards turn a visit into a memorable experience. The regional character is ever-present – Nice and Provence not only inspire the event but are also the source of many of the showcased specialties. The fair offers a feast for the senses while providing a well-organized venue for networking, inspiration, and the discovery of exceptional products. Located close to Nice Côte d’Azur Airport and well connected to public transport, the modern Palais Nikaia provides the perfect setting for this celebration of flavor, authenticity, and regional passion.

The "SAVOIR-VIVRE" wine fair in Hamburg is a real feast for wine lovers and gourmets. Organized by go! Pressebüro und Verlag GmbH, particularly known for the gourmet and travel magazine SAVOIR VIVRE, this fair is one of the most anticipated events in the German wine scene. The "SAVOIR-VIVRE" wine fair brings together a large number of exhibitors, including renowned wineries, wine cooperatives and importers. They come not only from different regions of Germany, but also from abroad to present their latest and best wines. Visitors have the unique opportunity to taste a variety of wines and learn directly from the winemakers what makes their products special. Wine lovers can also order their favorites directly on site to expand their domestic collections. A special feature of this fair is the combination of wine tasting with cultural experiences. Overall, the "SAVOIR-VIVRE" wine fair is more than just a wine tasting. It is a celebration of good taste, a platform for exchange between wine lovers and professionals, and a wonderful opportunity to experience the combination of culture, history and pleasure. The SAVOIR-VIVRE will take place on 2 days from Saturday, 24. October to Sunday, 25. October 2026 in Hamburg.

Aux Vignobles! is a vibrant experience for connoisseurs, born from the “Salon Vins & Gastronomie”, an annual event that draws wine lovers and industry professionals to Rennes. As part of a nationwide series with over 40 editions throughout France, the fair is among the most renowned platforms for showcasing French wine culture and regional gastronomy. It is organized by GL events Exhibitions – Division VIN & GASTRONOMIE, based in Brest, one of the country’s leading trade show organizers in the field of culinary arts and lifestyle. Held at the Rennes Parc Expo, a modern exhibition center with excellent transport connections and spacious halls, the event brings together winemakers from all major French wine regions. They present their wines in person – from traditional classics and organic vintages to innovative creations like craft beers and regional discoveries. This direct interaction with the producers creates an authentic, almost familial atmosphere, making the fair a truly special experience. For many attendees, this personal connection is precisely what brings them back year after year. But it’s not just about wine: “Aux Vignobles!” transforms into a “marketplace of flavors”, where selected regional specialties – from artisan cheeses and cured meats to fine foods and sweet delicacies – invite visitors to taste and purchase. The variety of high-quality, small-scale products, far removed from industrial mass production, appeals to both discerning food lovers and professional restaurateurs, reflecting the French passion for authenticity and quality. A standout feature is the temporary gourmet restaurant “Le Cépages”, created exclusively for the fair. Here, guests enjoy à la carte dishes expertly paired with wines featured at the event. The culinary offering is further enhanced by an educational program of workshops and masterclasses, providing in-depth insights into grape varieties, terroirs, and sensory analysis – a must for anyone looking to deepen their understanding of wine. For more relaxed moments of indulgence, the “L’Echanson” area offers live music, a convivial atmosphere, and a good glass of wine to round off the fair experience. Aux Vignobles! in Rennes is far more than a typical consumer fair – it’s an encounter with French terroir in all its diversity. Authentic, inspiring, and full of flavor, it offers a unique opportunity to meet producers, receive expert advice, and discover new culinary experiences – all in one place that has become a favorite annual meeting point for food and wine enthusiasts as well as industry professionals.

개최장소(베뉴): MEETT - Parc des Expositions et Centre de Conventions
축제소개: The "Salon Vins et Terroirs Toulouse" expo is a significant event in the world of wine and gourmet foods, with a focus on the culinary treasures of the region. The expo's name can be translated as the "Wine and Terroirs Salon of Toulouse", where "Terroirs" is a French term denoting the unique combination of climate, soil, and landscape that characterizes a specific wine-growing area. This biannual expo takes place at the esteemed MEETT - Parc des Expositions et Centre de Conventions in Aussonne, France. Organized by "Toulouse expo", the "Salon Vins et Terroirs Toulouse" not only showcases a remarkable selection of wines to its visitors but also offers a wide array of agricultural products, emphasizing its deep connection to the region and its significance for the local economy. A primary feature of the expo is gourmet products, which represent the diversity and quality of the French culinary scene. Highlights of the event include a wine-tasting workshop by Art of Wines, a Food Court, a farmer's market, and a gourmet bookstore. Special events, such as wine auctions, are a major draw for both exhibitors and attendees. Wine is an integral part of French culture and identity. Through its presentations, the expo accentuates this aspect and celebrates this culture. The majority of exhibitors hail from the wine and gourmet food industry, catering to both professionals in the field and enthusiasts alike. The Haute-Garonne region, where the exhibition takes place, benefits from its location within the expansive wine territory of Southwest France, boasting a rich wine tradition and history. The Fronton wine region, situated north of Toulouse, is particularly renowned for its grape variety called Négrette. This grape imparts red and rosé wines with a distinctive flavor, characterized by notes of violets, red fruits, and occasionally a hint of licorice. To the east of Toulouse, the Gaillac wine region has a storied history that dates back to Roman times. It is recognized for producing a variety of wine styles, including sparkling wines, dry white wines, red wines, and the sweet "Vin de Voile". Duras, Braucol, and Loin de l'Oeil are typical grape varieties of this region. Other noteworthy wine regions in Southwest France include Madiran and Pacherenc du Vic-Bilh. In conclusion, the MEETT - Parc des Expositions et Centre de Conventions in Aussonne impresses not only with its modern architecture but also its easy accessibility. The town of Aussonne itself offers a picturesque setting, making it the perfect place to unwind after an eventful day at the expo.

The 'Food Experience Taiwan' in Taipei is a trade fair dedicated to the allure and diversity of French gourmet products, wines, spirits, and kitchenware. Situated in the bustling heart of POPOP, it provides an impressive platform for exhibitors to showcase the crème de la crème of their products from France. The event is divided into two main sections: an exhibition hall where visitors can explore a multitude of stalls and discover the latest culinary creations from France, and an exclusive workshop area that invites in-depth culinary exchange. These workshops, led by renowned French gourmet experts, create an intimate setting for up to 50 participants. Here, they have the opportunity not only to learn about the unique features of French delicacies but also to witness firsthand how these products are demonstrated in culinary presentations and seminars. The fair's objective is to establish a connection between French culinary culture and the professionals of the food and beverage industry in Taiwan. Hence, representatives from cafes, hotels, restaurants, and even the agricultural and food industry are invited to participate. This annual gathering leads to the introduction of new French ingredients and products which are showcased not only to industry professionals but also to the general public in a specially organized press conference. It offers an excellent opportunity for Taiwanese media and influential personalities to get firsthand information about the latest trends from France. In summary, the 'Food Experience Taiwan' is not just a fair – it's a culinary voyage that brings the best of France directly to Taipei. An event that offers both exhibitors and visitors an unforgettable experience year after year.

전시회명: Salon des Vins des Vignerons Indépendants
축제소개: Salon des Vins des Vignerons Indépendants is an annual wine fair held since 2017 in the historic wine region of Reims. It is organized by the French association Vignerons Indépendants de France , which has long championed the visibility and recognition of independent, artisanal winemakers. Each year, the fair brings together independent winegrowers from across France—producers who oversee every step of the winemaking process, from vine to bottle. Visitors are not met with a faceless product showcase, but with personal encounters: winemakers themselves are present at their stands to share their stories, philosophies, and methods. This creates a unique atmosphere where wine is not just tasted, but experienced through dialogue—and purchased directly on site. A core objective of the event is to highlight the diversity of the French wine landscape. All major regions—from Bordeaux, Alsace, and the Loire to Provence—are represented. Equal visibility is a key principle: every exhibitor is given an identical stand, ensuring that smaller producers enjoy the same prominence as larger ones. The sensory experience is another major focus. In addition to free tastings, professionally guided workshops offer deeper insights into the world of wine—covering grape varieties, aroma profiles, and responsible consumption. Sustainability has also become increasingly important. Many winemakers now present themselves with organic certifications or carry the Haute Valeur Environnementale (HVE) label, which recognizes environmentally responsible farming practices. The fair thus reflects the industry’s broader shift toward ecological awareness and sustainable viticulture. A standout feature is the Concours des Vignerons Indépendants , a wine competition judged not by experts but by amateur wine enthusiasts. Here, authenticity, enjoyment, and personal taste take precedence over academic scoring—placing the character of the wines at the forefront. Award-winning wines receive a medal at the end of the fair, serving as a trusted mark of quality and distinction. The fair’s culinary offerings also come from regional producers. Food stalls provide a delicious complement to the wine tastings—with selections ranging from charcuterie and cheese to foie gras and fresh oysters. The event attracts wine lovers, trade professionals, restaurateurs, and curious consumers who value authenticity and a personal connection to what they enjoy. The Reims edition is part of a nationwide tour that also stops in cities like Paris, Lyon, and Strasbourg—each with the same mission: to give independent winemakers a stage. Located in the heart of Champagne, Reims offers a symbolically perfect setting for an event devoted to genuine, handcrafted wine—an ideal backdrop for celebrating tradition, craftsmanship, and the passion behind every bottle.

The Mürzer Messe is much more than a traditional consumer fair – it is an annual meeting point for regional economic strength, artisanal quality, culinary diversity, and engaging leisure activities, right in the heart of Mürzzuschlag. Once a year, the Mürzzuschlag town hall, together with the exhibition tent and the adjacent open-air grounds, transforms into a vibrant hub of innovation, exchange, and connection. The event is organized by the Mürzzuschlag Agency, which curates a diverse program with great dedication and a keen sense for regional identity. The fair brings together local businesses, craft enterprises, service providers, and professionals from a wide range of industries. Visitors will find everything from household appliances, furniture, and building materials to regionally produced clothing and fine jewelry design. A special focus is placed on regional foods and culinary specialties, lovingly presented at the street food market. The Mürzer Messe showcases the region’s capabilities – and tastes like home. But the fair is more than just a marketplace – it’s a celebration for all the senses. Artisanal stalls, a large funfair with amusement rides, the popular car exhibition, a pop-up market for start-ups, and a colorful children’s program with theatre, magic shows, and readings turn the event into an experience for the whole family. The pop-up café in the small town hall and the food corner on the town square invite guests to relax and create space for encounters and conversations. Exhibitors represent a broad spectrum of industries – from traditional crafts and innovative services to gastronomy and fine arts. The Mürzer Messe attracts not only private individuals and families, but also professionals and entrepreneurs from the region who use the opportunity to network and discover new products and collaborations. Whether taking a stroll through the amusement park at Holzwollbühel, sampling local delicacies, or engaging in conversations with regional artisans – the Mürzer Messe unites business, culture, and the joy of life like no other event in the region. The venue, located in the center of Mürzzuschlag, is easily accessible by train or car, with parking available nearby. Mürzzuschlag itself is a charming town in Styria, known for its excellent infrastructure, rich cultural offerings, and beautiful setting in the Styrian Alps.

The Plaza Culinaria in Freiburg im Breisgau, an annual pleasure fair held in November, is considered one of the most outstanding culinary events in Germany. Since its inception in 2004 by the Freiburg Wirtschaft Touristik und Messe GmbH & Co. KG, the fair has evolved into a true festival for all the senses, attracting both visitors and exhibitors who wish to celebrate the finer things in life. The fair is a haven for gourmets, offering a wide range of products and services. These include non-alcoholic beverages, organic delicacies, craft beers from local breweries, international delicacies and specialties, innovative gastronomy & catering services, as well as enticing offerings of coffee, tea, chocolate, pastries, and confectionery. For those interested in the culture of cooking, Plaza Culinaria showcases the latest trends in kitchen culture and related accessories. Additionally, areas such as culinary travel, themed literature, and home & living enhance the experience. Special attention is also given to sustainable living, with a variety of products for vegetarians and vegans. The "Christmas Magic" is another highlight of the fair, introducing a new themed area called "Trends & Lifestyle," encompassing everything from decorations to seasonal delicacies. Not to be overlooked is the selection of wines, sparkling wines, and spirits, appreciated by connoisseurs and novices alike. The event takes place at Messe Freiburg, a venue known for its modern facilities and its ability to accommodate a wide array of events. This location does not only provide ample space for the numerous exhibitors and visitors but also offers a pleasant atmosphere that encourages lingering, discovering, and indulging. In addition to the extensive range of exhibitors, Plaza Culinaria ensures an exciting supporting program with culinary entertainment highlights. These include live cooking shows, tastings led by industry experts, and workshops that give visitors the opportunity to learn directly from professionals. Overall, Plaza Culinaria is an experience that invites you to explore and celebrate the world of culinary delights with all your senses. It represents a combination of quality, diversity, and entertainment, thereby solidifying its status as one of the unmissable events for culinary enthusiasts.

FISCH&FEINES is a trade fair in Bremen dedicated to sustainable enjoyment and takes place every year in November. Since its founding in 2008, it has developed into the most important event for lovers of high-quality, handcrafted and natural products in the northwest. The trade fair is organized by M3B GmbH, which is committed to providing a platform for over 200 producers and retailers who present their selected foods to an enthusiastic audience. Only products that meet the strict quality criteria of FISCH&FEINES and do not contain any artificial flavors, chemical additives or flavor enhancers are admitted to the trade fair. A wide variety of products and services are offered at FISCH&FEINES. The range of products on offer ranges from fresh fish and seafood to a variety of delicatessen products such as cheese, meat, sausage, jams, chutneys, herbs, spices, salts and dairy products to fruit and vegetables. Drinks lovers will also get their money's worth with a selection of coffee, tea, wine, sparkling wine, beer and spirits. The exhibition offering is rounded off by a selection of cooking accessories, kitchen equipment and various services and informative offers. The focus is on the presentation of regional specialties, traditional manufacturing processes and high-quality products that are free of artificial additives. This trade fair is not only a feast for the senses, but also promotes awareness of sustainable consumption and supports smaller producers in making their passion and craft accessible to a wider audience. Overall, FISCH&FEINES is an indispensable event for connoisseurs and anyone interested in a sustainable lifestyle. It offers a unique opportunity to discover new taste experiences, be inspired by culinary innovations and talk directly to the producers. The CRAFT BEER EVENT has been taking place as part of FISCH&FEINES since 2014. Craft breweries from all over Germany and the Netherlands show that beer can have a lot of flavor. The ReiseLust holiday fair and caravan bremen also take place parallel to FISCH&FEINES, offering visitors an even more comprehensive experience.

The “ Mer & Vigne ” fair, held at the elegant venue La Palmeraie in La Tour-de-Salvagny, is an impressive tribute to the French way of life and the country’s rich culinary heritage. The name of the event – “Mer” meaning sea and “Vigne” meaning vine – highlights its central themes: exquisite seafood and fine wines from France’s renowned wine regions. As part of a nationwide event series, Mer & Vigne combines regional charm with national recognition. Held twice a year, the autumn edition is especially popular – a time when nature and cuisine reveal their full abundance. The fair is organized by Mer & Vigne SARL, an experienced event company known across France for its high-quality culinary events. Just a few kilometers from Lyon, La Tour-de-Salvagny offers a welcoming atmosphere that attracts gourmets and food lovers from near and far. At its core, the fair showcases products from the fields of fisheries, agriculture, and viticulture. Visitors can explore a wide range of offerings, from freshly caught seafood and artisanal delicacies to carefully selected wines from some of France’s most prestigious wine-growing regions. International specialties complement the assortment, adding a cosmopolitan flair to the event. A key focus of the fair is the support of regional producers. They are given a platform to present their high-quality products to a broad audience. Competitions and awards recognize excellence and creativity, creating special highlights throughout the event. The diversity of exhibitors reflects the rich culinary traditions of France. Alongside industry professionals, the fair also appeals to a wide audience of fine food enthusiasts in search of authentic products and new taste experiences. Thanks to its convenient location, Mer & Vigne is easily accessible for visitors from across France. La Tour-de-Salvagny lies approximately 15 kilometers from Lyon’s city center and is well connected via the A6 and A89 motorways. The town itself offers a picturesque setting, with views of the nearby golf course and surrounding landscape. La Palmeraie de la Tour is a popular venue for a variety of events – from weddings and corporate gatherings to trade fairs such as “Mer & Vigne.” With its tropical-inspired ambiance and versatile layout, it provides an ideal setting for special occasions. Mer & Vigne is a true feast for the senses – a place where tradition meets innovation, and where local character blends seamlessly with international flair to create a unique and memorable experience.

The "Salon du BON" is a public fair dedicated to the world of gastronomy, wine, and culinary delights. The name "Salon du BON" reflects the fair's aim to emphasize the outstanding aspects of gastronomy – "BON" meaning "good" or "high quality". It takes place annually at the Grande Halle de la Villette in Paris, a location known for its cultural diversity and significance in the French capital. The Salon du BON is organized by JPC EVENTS in cooperation with renowned chef Thierry Marx and Bon Magazine, also initiated by Marx. The fair's objective is to bring haute cuisine closer to a wide audience. It serves as a platform for esteemed chefs, local producers, and culinary artisans to present their products and services. The main themes of the fair include the art of table setting, quality products, culinary expertise, gastronomic experiments, the art of beverages, and equipment. The fair has a strong connection to the city of Paris, considered one of the world's gastronomic capitals. It offers visitors the opportunity to participate in high-quality tastings, attend entertaining workshops, and meet experts from the culinary world. The exhibitors come from various industries, including gastronomy, viticulture, and culinary crafts. The Salon du BON attracts a broad spectrum of visitors, from experienced gourmets to newcomers in the world of gastronomy. In conclusion, the Grande Halle de la Villette in Paris is not only easily accessible but also possesses a rich history and impressive architecture, which contribute to the overall experience of the fairgoers. Therefore, the Salon du BON is a must-visit for anyone looking to explore the diverse and exquisite world of gastronomy.

WeinDüsseldorf (Autumn) is an exclusive wine fair of national and international renown, held annually in the elegant setting of the five-star Hotel Kö59 in the heart of Düsseldorf. The name of the event not only reflects its location, but also stands for an exceptional experience centered around wine culture, vintage presentations, and the joy of fine taste. For one weekend, the Rhine metropolis becomes a hub for the global wine community. The fair is organized by weberMESSE GmbH, based in Bonn, a company widely recognized across Germany for hosting high-quality wine events. With many years of experience, it presents WeinDüsseldorf as part of a nationwide series of premium wine fairs in major cities. At the heart of the autumn edition are the newly bottled wines of the current vintage—particularly the red Pinot varieties, which are ideally suited to the cooler season and traditional roast dishes. More than 900 wines from domestic and international producers can be sampled, and purchased or ordered directly from the winemakers. This offering appeals not only to trade professionals and fine dining establishments but also to discerning wine enthusiasts and connoisseurs. A hallmark of the event is its personal presentation: winemakers are present to introduce their wines, share insights into their origins and production methods, and foster a direct, authentic connection between producer and visitor. The fair offers a comprehensive overview of the diverse world of wine regions. Renowned German growing areas such as Mosel, Saar, Ahr, Nahe, Rheingau, Franconia, Palatinate, Baden, and Württemberg are represented alongside top international regions from Europe and beyond—including France, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Austria, Greece, California, South Africa, Chile, Argentina, Australia, New Zealand, and Turkey. Independent winemakers, established family estates, experienced cooperatives, and innovative importers meet an audience that values quality, craftsmanship, and variety. To support orientation and follow-up, all visitors receive a detailed exhibition catalogue featuring information about exhibitors, wines, and expert recommendations. As part of a nationwide event series, WeinDüsseldorf (Autumn) brings the world of wine to North Rhine-Westphalia, reinforcing Düsseldorf’s position as a wine capital with international appeal. Hotel Kö59 on the famous Königsallee provides not only an elegant setting, but—thanks to its central location and excellent transport connections—is also easily accessible for out-of-town guests, whether arriving by train, car, or plane. For anyone wishing to experience wine with all their senses, this is the perfect place to do so.

Wein & More is much more than a traditional trade fair – it’s a delightful experience that takes place twice a year in the stylish setting of the Bürgerhaus Neukeferloh, located in the district of the same name within the municipality of Grassbrunn near Munich. As both a trade and public event, it caters equally to industry professionals – including sommeliers, restaurateurs, winemakers, and merchants – as well as to wine enthusiasts and food lovers from the region and beyond. Organized by Ingo Raibold, Wein & More serves as a platform for high-quality indulgence, personal exchange, and professional inspiration. Over the course of two days, the Bürgerhaus Neukeferloh transforms into a hub of culinary discovery: national and international exhibitors showcase their latest wine creations, premium spirits, fine cheeses and chocolates, gourmet foods, and other delicacies. At the heart of the event are quality, authenticity, and direct interaction between producers and visitors – a hallmark that gives the fair its unique character. The concept centers on creating a rich experience with added value. In addition to traditional tastings, visitors can enjoy a thoughtfully curated supporting program featuring workshops, seminars, expert talks, and culinary shows. Specialists from the wine and gourmet industries share up-to-date knowledge on topics such as wine storage, sensory analysis, and food pairing, offer insights into current trends, and are available for personal discussions. This combination of information, inspiration, and sensory enjoyment makes Wein & More a key event for anyone with a professional or personal interest in wine and fine food. Thanks to its biannual schedule, visitors have regular access to seasonal highlights and the latest innovations in the industry. The Bürgerhaus Neukeferloh provides the ideal setting for this – modern, spacious facilities with high-quality furnishings and a pleasant atmosphere that perfectly reflects the event’s emphasis on style and indulgence. Wein & More is not just a showcase for premium products – it’s a social event that brings together people who appreciate quality and taste, while offering direct connections to the creators behind the brands.

The "SAVOIR-VIVRE" Wine Fair, a biannual event, is a true celebration for wine enthusiasts and gourmets alike. Hosted by go! Press Office and Publishing Ltd., especially known for the gourmet and travel magazine SAVOIR VIVRE, this fair is one of the most anticipated events in the German wine scene. This event is held twice a year, spanning a weekend each in spring and autumn, taking place in the historic and exceptional premises of the Great Orangery of Charlottenburg Palace in Berlin. This magnificent location is not just a piece of living history; with its elegant ambiance, it also provides the perfect backdrop for an event dedicated to pleasure. The "SAVOIR-VIVRE" Wine Fair gathers a multitude of exhibitors, including renowned vineyards, winegrower cooperatives, and importers. They come not only from various regions of Germany but also travel from abroad to present their latest and greatest wines. Visitors have the unique opportunity to taste a variety of wines and learn directly from the winemakers what makes their products special. Additionally, wine lovers can order their favorites on the spot, expanding their personal collections. A distinctive feature of this fair is the combination of wine tasting with cultural experiences. Visitors can not only sample exquisite wines but also have the opportunity to tour the famous Charlottenburg Palace. With its impressive architecture and artful gardens, the palace invites guests for an unforgettable weekend stroll. The palace park, an attraction in its own right, offers a wonderful opportunity to round off the wine tasting with a walk in picturesque surroundings. The ease of accessibility to the venue via public transport ensures a stress-free arrival. For those arriving by car, there are parking facilities nearby. Overall, the "SAVOIR-VIVRE" Wine Fair is more than just a wine tasting. It's a celebration of fine taste, a platform for exchange between wine aficionados and professionals, and a wonderful opportunity to experience the blend of culture, history, and pleasure.

The " JAPAN'S FOOD EXPORT FAIR" (JFEF) is an annual trade fair for importers, wholesalers and buyers of Japanese food and beverages and held at Makuhari Messe in Chiba, near Tokyo. It serves as a central hub for the export of Japanese food and beverages. The event is organized by RX Japan Ltd., a leader in the organization of international large-scale events. The fair's goal is to bridge Japanese exporters and global markets. The fair's offerings include a wide range of products: fresh agricultural produce, seafood, meat products, processed foods, and Japanese tea varieties such as green tea, Matcha, Sencha, and Genmaicha. Additionally, Japanese beverages like sake and beer, non-alcoholic options, confectioneries, snacks, health-oriented foods, sustainable and allergen-free products, as well as traditional spices and sauces are highlighted. The fair also showcases the latest trends in kitchen appliances and tableware. In addition to product presentations, the JFEF provides comprehensive services in logistics and transportation, facilitating international trade. It attracts numerous visitors, including foreign importers, traders, international trade associations, government institutions, and media representatives. Primary visitors also include buyers from retail, department stores, hotels, restaurants, and the food processing industry. A distinctive feature of the fair is its highlights, such as tastings, sushi-making workshops, and business matchmaking activities. These offerings enrich the fair with a vibrant experience that not only promotes business exchange but also provides deep cultural insights and strengthens the relationship between Japanese culture and global markets. The JFEF is part of a series of fairs and is held in one of Japan's leading exhibition halls. Its modern infrastructure and accessibility, combined with its proximity to Tokyo, provide an attractive incentive for international visitors who seek not only business opportunities but also cultural enrichment. In summary, the JAPAN'S FOOD EXPORT FAIR is an essential platform for stakeholders in the international food trade to explore the diversity and quality of Japanese products and to establish direct contacts with leading manufacturers and exporters.

The "JAPAN'S FOOD EXPORT FAIR" (JFEF) is an annual trade fair for importers, wholesalers and buyers of Japanese food and beverages, held at the Tokyo Big Sight in Tokyo. It has established itself as a central hub for exporting Japanese food and beverages. The event is organized by RX Japan Ltd., a leader in organizing large international events, with the aim of connecting Japanese exporters to global markets. The fair offers a wide range of products including fresh agricultural produce, seafood, meat products, processed foods, and a variety of Japanese teas such as green tea, matcha, sencha, and genmaicha. Additionally, Japanese beverages like sake and beer, non-alcoholic alternatives, confections, snacks, and health-oriented foods are presented. Sustainable and allergen-free products, as well as traditional spices and sauces, are also highlighted. The fair additionally showcases the latest trends in kitchen appliances and tableware. Besides product presentations, the JFEF provides comprehensive logistics and transportation services to facilitate international trade. It attracts a diverse group of visitors including foreign importers, traders, international trade associations, government institutions, and media representatives. The main attendees include buyers from retail, department stores, hotels, restaurants, and the food processing industry. A distinctive feature of the fair are its highlights such as tastings, sushi-making workshops, and business matchmaking activities, which not only promote business exchange but also offer deep cultural insights and strengthen the relationship between Japanese culture and global markets. The JFEF is part of a series of fairs and takes place in one of Japan's leading exhibition halls. Thanks to its modern infrastructure and convenient location in the heart of Tokyo, Tokyo Big Sight offers an attractive incentive for international visitors seeking not only business opportunities but also cultural enrichment.
