The FoodExpo Kazakhstan, formerly also known as Worldfood Kazakhstan, is a prominent trade fair in the Asian region, contributing since its inception in 1998 to the presentation of trends, products, and technologies in food production and marketing on an international platform. The expo, taking place annually at the Atakent International Exhibition Centre in Almaty, has established itself as an effective platform for introducing new products and networking with industry experts from the global food industry. The fair is organized by Iteca Almaty, an experienced organizer, which has shaped the FoodExpo into a crucial platform for companies from all over the world to present their products and services to a wide audience. With main themes extending across food and beverages, ingredients, food technology, baked goods, packaging, and agriculture, the expo offers a comprehensive range that spans from food to production and packaging equipment, through to agricultural topics and discussions. The AgriFood Forum is a special highlight of the FoodExpo, addressing issues such as animal husbandry, feed production, and efficient gardening. Here, professionals from various sectors have the opportunity to exchange ideas, expand networks, and discuss current challenges and innovations in the industry. In addition to the forum, the FoodExpo also hosts the competition and award "The Best Product of FoodExpo Qazaqstan," which serves as a prestigious event within the fair and honors innovative products. Exhibitors from various industries such as food production, retail and wholesale, catering, and packaging present their products and services at the fair. Visitors, primarily from manufacturing, trade, catering, and distribution sectors, can discover a variety of products and technologies, which include food, beverages, equipment, additives, packaging, transport solutions, and numerous other subject areas. The fair not only strengthens the relationship between national and international players in the food industry but also offers an excellent opportunity to showcase the diversity and quality of the Kazakh food sector. Almaty, being one of the largest cities in Kazakhstan and a significant economic center, provides an optimally accessible location for national and international guests with the Atakent International Exhibition Centre. This exhibition center is not only a hub for international business activities but also symbolizes Kazakhstan's openness towards global markets and trends. It is easily accessible by both public transport and car and offers comprehensive facilities and services for exhibitors and visitors alike. Thus, the FoodExpo Kazakhstan forms a comprehensive, culturally, and economically significant event, promoting the exchange and presentation of innovations in the food industry and acting as a bridge between local and international market participants.

전시회명: JFEX JAPAN INT’L FOOD & BEVERAGE EXPO
축제소개: The "JFEX Summer JAPAN INT'L FOOD & BEVERAGE EXPO", an international fair in Tokyo, is dedicated to showcasing food and beverages from around the world. "JFEX", short for "Japan Food Expo", reflects the event's focus on the food industry. This trade fair takes place twice a year at Tokyo Big Sight, one of Japan's leading exhibition centers. It is organized by RX Japan Ltd., a company known for its extensive experience and expertise in organizing international exhibitions. JFEX is divided into four main areas: JFEX FOOD, focusing on frozen foods, ready-to-eat meals, agricultural and seafood products, confectionery, and spices; JFEX WINE and SPIRITS, presenting alcoholic beverages such as wine, beer, whisky, liqueurs, sake, and shochu; JFEX MEAT and DAIRY, specializing in meat and dairy products; and JFEX PREMIUM, showcasing luxury food items, confectionery, agricultural products, and both alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages. The fair offers an excellent platform for exploring the diversity and innovations of the global food and beverage industry, particularly from Japan. It provides insights into current trends and serves as a meeting point for business contacts and networking. Exhibitors range from food and beverage manufacturers to agricultural companies and providers of packaging and processing technologies. The main visitors include professionals from the food industry, retailers and wholesalers, importers, exporters, and restaurateurs. JFEX is not only a central meeting point for professionals but also reflects the local culture and gastronomy. Tokyo, the venue, is known for its culinary diversity and its role as a trade and industrial center. As part of a global series of fairs representing the food and beverage industry, JFEX plays a significant role in the sector. Tokyo Big Sight in Tokyo stands out for its strategically advantageous location and excellent accessibility. It is an ideal place for international exhibitions and boasts an excellent infrastructure that is easily accessible by both public transport and car, facilitating participation for international visitors and exhibitors.

Once a year, "Aux Vignobles!" invites visitors on a delightful journey through the rich wine and culinary traditions of France. This combined trade and public fair, with a clear focus on wine, gastronomy, and terroir, takes place at the Centre des Expositions in Le Mans. The name – roughly translated as “To the Vineyards!” – symbolizes the experience that awaits: direct encounters with winemakers, authentic regional products, and a deep dive into French culture of taste and craftsmanship. Organized by GL Events Exhibitions Opérations, based in Brest, the event is part of a series of similar fairs curated across northwestern France by this experienced exhibition organizer. Le Mans – widely known for its motorsport heritage – also benefits from its proximity to renowned wine regions such as the Loire Valley. Each autumn, it becomes a unique gathering place where local residents, wine enthusiasts, tourists, and professionals from the hospitality, gastronomy, and retail sectors come together to discover, taste, and purchase regional quality products directly from the producers. At the heart of the fair is French wine in all its diversity: from classic appellations and rare grape varieties to sustainable viticulture, current trends in oenology, and offers from the wine tourism sector. Many exhibitors also present travel experiences linked to their wineries – ranging from on-site tastings to overnight stays among the vines. A standout feature of the fair is the "Parcours BIO" – a dedicated route through the exhibition hall spotlighting organic wines and sustainably certified products, including those carrying the HVE (Haute Valeur Environnementale) environmental label. This focus underlines the event’s strong commitment to transparency, sustainability, and regional identity. The exhibition is further enriched by free tasting workshops, where experts share their knowledge of aromas, growing regions, and terroirs, allowing visitors to deepen their understanding of wine. In addition to wine, Aux Vignobles! features a curated selection of fine delicacies – including cheese, cured meats, chocolate, honey, tea, and more. Most exhibitors come from the fields of viticulture, agriculture, gourmet food production, and tourism. More than just a sales exhibition, "Aux Vignobles!" serves as a vibrant showcase of French culinary culture – a space for direct exchange between producers and the public, and a stage for quality, authenticity, and emotion. The venue – the modern Centre des Expositions Le Mans – is located just a few kilometers from the city center and is easily accessible by car or public transport. Thanks to its strong connection to the French rail network, the fair is also convenient for regional and national visitors. Anyone wishing to experience French wine culture in all its richness will find at "Aux Vignobles!" in Le Mans a unique and valuable opportunity to taste the best of France’s regions – where people and pleasure come together.

WeinMünchen (Winter) is a characterful and pleasure-oriented wine fair held every November on Munich’s historic Praterinsel. In addition to the winter edition, further events take place in the Bavarian capital during spring and autumn, establishing the fair as a firm fixture in both the regional and national wine scene. What sets WeinMünchen (Winter) apart is its clear thematic focus and welcoming, personal atmosphere. Each year, the Praterinsel transforms into a meeting point for wine lovers, industry professionals and connoisseurs eager to explore new vintages and current releases. Special attention is given to Pinot Noir, whose depth of flavor makes it an ideal match for the start of the roast season. Alongside premium German wines from renowned regions such as the Mosel, Ahr, Rheingau and Baden, the fair also offers a diverse international selection, including wines from Italy, Spain, France, Austria, South Africa, Chile and Australia. Visitors can taste wines on-site and purchase or order them directly from winemakers, family-run estates, cooperatives or established importers. Personal interaction is central to the experience: many exhibitors are present in person, ready to answer questions and share insights into their work and philosophy. An engaging supporting program enhances the overall fair experience. In guided tastings and presentations, producers share their in-depth knowledge, explain vintage variations, and demonstrate how terroir, winemaking methods and grape varieties shape a wine’s character. The fair attracts a diverse audience: private customers, wine retailers, restaurateurs, sommeliers and wine enthusiasts of all experience levels come together to discover new trends, make valuable connections and find fresh inspiration. The event is designed for both professional buyers and curious wine lovers in search of something special. As part of a nationwide series of wine events, WeinMünchen (Winter) stands out for its seasonal focus, personal charm and high-quality exhibitor lineup. Its location on the Praterinsel offers a unique venue in the heart of Munich – centrally situated, easily accessible by public transport, and blending the flair of an exclusive wine event with the spirit of urban culture.

개최국: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
축제소개: Bellavita Expo London is the leading trade show in the United Kingdom dedicated entirely to high-quality Italian food and beverage culture. Once a year, the prestigious ExCeL London opens its doors to this key industry event, organized by Bellavita Expo Ltd. – a company committed to promoting Italian culinary excellence on a global scale. Exclusively aimed at trade professionals, the expo brings together decision-makers from the hospitality, retail, and wholesale sectors with carefully selected Italian producers and exporters. The focus lies on authentic “Made in Italy” products, complemented by Mediterranean specialties from countries such as Spain, Greece, and Croatia. The product range includes fine wines and spirits, traditional cheeses and cured meats, fresh seafood, artisanal pasta, innovative convenience foods, premium ingredients for the foodservice sector, and cutting-edge kitchen technology. More than just a product showcase, Bellavita Expo also serves as a dynamic platform for knowledge exchange, networking, and trend discovery. Through masterclasses, expert-led seminars, and panel discussions, attendees gain insights into the latest developments in the food and hospitality industries. Live tastings, product competitions, and award ceremonies create interactive experiences and give companies the opportunity to demonstrate their innovation and quality. Classic Italian dishes such as pizza and pasta take center stage, alongside modern culinary concepts and technologies. As part of a global event series, Bellavita Expo is held annually in other major cities. This international reach highlights its role as a strategic platform for producers looking to enter new markets – particularly in the dynamic and highly competitive UK market. The venue, ExCeL London, is a state-of-the-art exhibition centre located in the heart of the British capital, with excellent public transport links via the DLR and Elizabeth Line, and close proximity to London City Airport. As a vibrant global city, London offers the perfect setting to present the diversity and quality of Italian and Mediterranean food culture to a discerning professional audience from across the UK and beyond. Bellavita Expo London is therefore more than just a trade fair – it is an immersive experience that brings together taste, innovation, and business opportunities in a truly unique way.

Salon du Chocolat in Toronto is Canada’s leading exhibition dedicated to chocolate, cocoa, pâtisserie and confectionery. Bringing together indulgence, craftsmanship, innovation and international industry expertise under one roof, it offers far more than a traditional chocolate show. As part of the globally renowned Salon du Chocolat series, the event serves as an international platform for the entire cocoa and chocolate value chain, from cocoa-growing regions and bean production to the latest creations of leading chocolatiers, pastry chefs and dessert specialists. The event takes place at the Toronto Congress Centre, one of Canada’s largest and most modern exhibition and convention venues. It is organised by Comexposium, a France-based organiser and one of the world’s leading exhibition groups. Comexposium delivers numerous international trade and consumer events across a wide range of industries and is particularly recognised for its high-quality B2B and consumer exhibitions. At the heart of Salon du Chocolat Toronto are premium chocolates, high-quality cocoa products, bean-to-bar concepts, artisanal production methods, and the increasingly important topics of cocoa origin and sustainability. More than 120 exhibitors showcase chocolate specialities, pralines, cocoa products, desserts, baked goods, ice cream and confectionery creations, as well as innovative ingredients and technologies for the chocolate and pastry sectors. The exhibition is further complemented by services relating to production, packaging, distribution, foodservice, training and business consultancy. The event plays an important role within Canada and particularly within the Greater Toronto area. As the country’s largest city and a major international business and cultural hub, Toronto provides an ideal setting for dialogue between North American and global market participants. The exhibition brings together producers from leading cocoa-growing countries with Canadian and international chocolate manufacturers, distributors, buyers and retailers, helping to strengthen global industry connections. One of the event’s best-known attractions is the spectacular Chocolate Fashion Show, the signature feature of the Salon du Chocolat brand. Designers and chocolatiers collaborate to create extraordinary fashion pieces made wholly or partly from chocolate. The programme also includes tastings, live demonstrations by renowned pastry chefs and chocolatiers, interactive workshops, expert presentations and immersive experiences exploring cocoa and chocolate production. Visitors also gain exclusive insights into the latest trends shaping the international worlds of desserts and chocolate artistry. Exhibitors primarily represent the chocolate manufacturing, cocoa production, pâtisserie, confectionery, bakery, confectionery manufacturing, hospitality, food processing, packaging technology and retail sectors. Participants range from global brands and specialist artisan producers to bean-to-bar makers, suppliers and innovative start-ups. The visitor profile is equally diverse. Alongside chocolate enthusiasts and consumers, the exhibition attracts professionals from pâtisserie, confectionery, hospitality, hotel management, retail, import and export, food manufacturing, wholesale distribution, procurement and product development. This successful combination of consumer appeal and professional networking makes the event both a public exhibition and a valuable industry platform. Salon du Chocolat Toronto forms part of an international exhibition series staged in major cities around the world. In addition to Toronto, editions are held in destinations including Paris, New York, London, Brussels, Dubai and Tokyo. As a result, the event benefits from the strength of a globally recognised brand and an extensive network within the international chocolate and cocoa industry. With its unique blend of indulgence, expertise, innovation and entertainment, Salon du Chocolat Toronto ranks among the most important events in the North American chocolate and pastry sectors. The Toronto Congress Centre provides an outstanding venue, offering modern infrastructure, expansive exhibition space and a convenient location close to Toronto Pearson International Airport. Excellent road links, public transport connections and international air access ensure that the venue is easily accessible for both domestic and international visitors.

Since its inception in 2024, the “ Food und Feines ” trade fair has stood for culinary discovery and a refined culture of enjoyment – authentic, regionally rooted, and globally open-minded. Each year, Messe Stuttgart welcomes a discerning audience passionate about new taste experiences, creative cuisine, and sustainable nutrition. Organized by Landesmesse Stuttgart GmbH, the event offers a carefully curated platform for producers, culinary professionals, and conscious consumers alike, shaped by a strong sense for quality and innovation. The Food und Feines presents itself as a showcase of culinary diversity. While the spotlight is on regional specialties from Baden-Württemberg – including beloved classics like Maultaschen, cheese, and artisan sausages – the fair also opens the door to international delicacies. Visitors can explore the culinary riches of the Levant, the Mediterranean, Asia, and South America, bringing global food traditions to life. Complementing this selection are fine coffee and confectionery specialties rarely found outside gourmet roasteries or international markets – from frozen yogurt to premium chocolate from Dubai. Beverages are given equal attention. A thoughtfully selected range of wines, beers, spirits, and non-alcoholic creations invites exploration. The focus is on craft and authenticity, with offerings such as small-batch beers, naturally brewed lemonades, regional brandies, and international whiskies. A stylishly designed area is dedicated to tobacco and cigar culture, featuring curated accessories and expert advice. The overall experience is further enhanced by high-quality lifestyle products for the modern home, including elegant tableware, kitchen tools, and culinary literature that inspire stylish enjoyment at home. The fair places a strong emphasis on sustainability, slow food, and mindful consumption. Expert panels and discussion formats highlight pressing topics such as regional value creation, fair production, and resource-conscious nutrition. A particular highlight are the live cooking shows with renowned chefs who share insights into global food trends – from Asian street food and African spice culture to traditional bread baking and BBQ. These sessions offer not only culinary inspiration, but also fresh perspectives on food and enjoyment. Exhibitors represent sectors such as artisanal food production, gastronomy, beverage manufacturing, fine food retail, kitchen equipment, and lifestyle. The event is tailored to gourmets, food lovers, industry professionals from retail, hospitality, and gastronomy, as well as trend-conscious home cooks. In this way, “Food und Feines” builds a unique bridge between craftsmanship, culinary culture, and responsible food practices – true to the spirit of the Stuttgart region, known for its rich and forward-thinking culinary landscape. Modern Messe Stuttgart, located directly at the airport and perfectly connected to the transport network, provides the ideal setting. Bright, spacious halls, well-designed lounge areas, and short walking distances ensure a pleasant visitor experience. For those who value enjoyment grounded in quality, diversity, and integrity, “Food und Feines” is a true culinary highlight in the southern German trade fair calendar.

Aux Vignobles! in Limoges is far more than a traditional wine fair. It is an invitation to gourmets, food lovers, industry professionals, and wine enthusiasts to discover the rich culinary heritage of France in all its diversity. This long-standing event takes place every autumn at the Parc des Expositions de Limoges and is part of an established series of exhibitions held in several cities across northwestern France. The organizer, GL Events Exhibitions Opérations, based in Brest, is a seasoned player in the French trade fair industry, renowned for regionally rooted, quality-focused event formats. The name Aux Vignobles! captures the essence of the event: wine and spirits take center stage—premium products, often organically produced, that embody France’s savoir-faire when it comes to indulgence and taste. Yet, the fair goes far beyond the presentation of fine wines. It celebrates artisanal craftsmanship, regional gastronomy, and the direct connection between producers and visitors. Whether it’s chocolate, cheese, cured meats, tea, or wines with protected designation of origin, the offerings are not only wide-ranging but also highly specialized. Many products are certified organic or carry the HVE (Haute Valeur Environnementale) label, indicating environmentally sustainable production. A particular highlight is the dedicated organic producers’ trail, offering visitors clear guidance and an in-depth experience of sustainable gourmet culture. The event is further enriched by the growing segment of wine tourism: wineries that double as tourist destinations showcase their experiences—from wine seminars and tastings to overnight stays at vineyard estates. The fair serves as a platform not only for regional producers in agriculture, artisanal food production, and beverages, but also specifically targets trade visitors from retail, gastronomy, and tourism. At the same time, private visitors benefit from direct sales, expert advice, exclusive discoveries, and fair prices—making for an experience that is both informative and pleasurable. Aux Vignobles! is therefore more than just a trade fair—it is a sensory journey through the French terroir, and a strong statement in favor of quality, regional identity, and personal connection between producers and consumers in an increasingly standardized world. The venue, the modern Parc des Expositions in Limoges, offers excellent transport links. Whether arriving by car, train, or public transit, the centrally located site in the charming city of Limoges—nestled in the heart of France—makes for an easy journey and invites visitors to enjoy a cultural and culinary stay in a region famed for its craftsmanship and distinctive way of life.

Aux Vignobles! in Angers is much more than a traditional consumer fair – it’s a sensory experience for wine lovers, food enthusiasts, and anyone looking to enjoy French hospitality in its most authentic form. The name of the event – which translates to “To the Vineyards!” – says it all: visitors are invited on a flavorful journey through the diverse wine regions of France – without ever having to leave Angers. Held annually and organized by GL Events Exhibitions Opérations, based in Brest, the fair brings together winemakers, producers, and artisanal food specialists from across the French culinary landscape. Every autumn, it transforms the Parc des Expositions in Angers into a vibrant hub of culinary discovery. A visit to Aux Vignobles! is especially rewarding for those in search of authenticity. Products can be purchased directly from the producers – with personal advice, expert knowledge, and the chance to experience the quality and flavor firsthand. Regional diversity takes center stage, with numerous appellations from across France – from Bordeaux to Alsace, from the Loire to the Rhône Valley – showcasing what makes the French terroir so exceptional. Within just a few hours, visitors can embark on a genuine culinary journey through the country. A standout feature is the organic trail ( Bio-Parcours ), which highlights producers committed to ecological and sustainable farming and production methods. Certifications such as HVE (Haute Valeur Environnementale) clearly indicate which producers follow particularly eco-conscious practices. This focus on sustainability is seamlessly integrated into a holistic wine experience: tastings, samplings, and guided tours offer deeper insights into the art of oenology. But it’s not just about fine wines – the culinary offerings are rounded out with gourmet specialties such as cheese, charcuterie, chocolate, and artisan-crafted delicacies. Exhibitors represent a wide range of sectors including food production, viticulture, and gastronomy. The audience includes both trade professionals – from retail, hospitality, and food service – and private visitors with a passion for good taste. Aux Vignobles! is part of a series of events held in several cities across northwestern France. In Angers, the fair opens its doors once a year in the autumn – the perfect time to explore new vintages and prepare for the culinary delights of the colder season. Thanks to its convenient location and modern infrastructure, the Parc des Expositions in Angers is easily accessible – whether by car via the A11 or by public transport from Angers-Saint-Laud railway station. The city of Angers itself, located in the heart of the Loire Valley, is a historic center of culture and wine – offering the ideal backdrop for a fair that uniquely blends wine, gastronomy, and the French art de vivre .

Since its founding in 1989, SAVIM – short for Salon des Vins et de la Gastronomie Méditerranéenne – has established itself as one of the most important fine food and gourmet fairs in southern France. Held twice a year, the event transforms the Parc Chanot exhibition center in Marseille into a culinary meeting point for food lovers, professionals, and producers. Organized by SAVIM EXPO SARL, the fair offers a distinctive setting for exchange and discovery, shaped by a strong focus on quality, authenticity, and regional diversity. SAVIM is more than a traditional consumer fair – it is an immersive journey through the culinary landscapes of France. Only carefully selected winegrowers from prestigious regions such as Bordeaux, Bourgogne, Champagne, and Provence are featured. Their offerings are complemented by premium spirits, craft beers, and refined non-alcoholic beverages. Established in 2017, the Rum Fair PUEBLO DEL RON, organized by AFAG Messen und Ausstellungen GmbH, is an annual event held in spring at the Nuremberg Exhibition Center. he Whisk(e)y Fair Nuremberg, THE VILLAGE, takes place annually in spring and has established itself since its inception in 2013 as a significant meeting point for whisk(e)y enthusiasts worldwide. Lähiruoka & Luomu is a trade fair in Finland specializing in regional and organic food. The name is derived from the Finnish terms "Lähiruoka" (regional food) and "Luomu" (organic products), symbolizing high-quality, sustainable nutrition. As an integral part of the renowned Kevät Messut, this unique fair takes place annually in spring at the Messukeskus Helsinki, offering visitors the opportunity to explore the diversity of Finnish small-scale producers and sustainable food. The fair is organized by Messukeskus Helsinki, Finland's largest trade and convention center. Thanks to its central location and excellent infrastructure, it provides optimal conditions for exhibitors and visitors alike. The event highlights key topics such as regional food production, organic farming, and sustainable nutrition trends. It offers deep insights into a responsible food culture, bringing together producers, retailers, restaurateurs, and consumers. The fair serves as a platform for exchanging ideas on current developments in the food industry and discovering new products. The product range is diverse, spanning from artisanal meat and dairy products to grain-based foods, root vegetables, and traditional specialties, as well as innovative protein sources such as hemp. The fair also features organic ice cream, preserved foods, and canned goods. In addition to opportunities for tasting and purchasing products, the event offers a varied program, including cooking demonstrations, expert lectures, and workshops. Visitors receive valuable tips on sustainable nutrition and gain insights into organic certifications, eco-friendly production methods, and fair trade practices. A particular highlight of the fair is the presentation of the "Vuoden lähiruokateko" award ("Local Food Action of the Year"), which honors outstanding initiatives promoting regional food. This competition raises awareness of sustainable production and provides small businesses with a platform to showcase their innovations. The fair attracts exhibitors from various sectors, including organic farmers, local producers, gourmet food retailers, gastronomy businesses, and food technology companies. It also serves as a valuable networking platform for retailers, restaurant owners, and professionals in the food industry, facilitating new business opportunities. The main visitors include environmentally conscious consumers, professionals from the hospitality industry, and key decision-makers in the food sector. Lähiruoka & Luomu has established itself as a key event in Finland’s trade fair calendar, making a significant contribution to raising awareness of sustainable nutrition. As an integral part of Kevät Messut, it benefits from a broad audience and synergies with other thematic fairs in the areas of gardening, home living, and outdoor activities. Messukeskus Helsinki, the venue of the event, is not only Finland’s most important exhibition center but also conveniently accessible. It is well connected by public transport and easily reachable by car. Its central location in the Finnish capital makes it an ideal destination for both national and international visitors looking to be inspired at one of Northern Europe’s most modern exhibition venues.

CAFEXPO Honduras is the most important trade fair for specialty coffee in Honduras and enjoys a strong international reputation. Each year, the prestigious Copantl Hotel & Convention Center in San Pedro Sula transforms into a vibrant hub for the global coffee community. Organized by the Honduran Coffee Institute (IHCAFE), the event uniquely brings together expertise, innovation, and the country’s deeply rooted coffee culture. More than just a conventional trade fair, CAFEXPO serves as a specialized platform focused on quality, origin, and the future of the coffee sector. Producers, exporters, roasters, machinery manufacturers, packaging experts, baristas, and service providers from Honduras and around the world gather to exchange insights, share innovations, and foster new business opportunities. At the heart of it all: Honduran coffee – from select microlots and cutting-edge processing methods to roasting trends and creative value-added products such as cascara, cold brews, and specialty infusions. A particular highlight of the fair includes high-level cuppings, live roasting sessions, hands-on brewing techniques, and expert presentations on topics such as quality assurance, export strategies, market opportunities, and sustainable cultivation. The national coffee competition, along with the presentation of prestigious awards, positions CAFEXPO as a showcase of excellence and traceability. CAFEXPO’s significance for Honduras cannot be overstated. It highlights not only the economic and cultural importance of coffee to the country but also strategically connects the local industry with international markets and trends. The event targets decision-makers, buyers, baristas, start-ups, and coffee enthusiasts alike – in short, anyone who wants to actively shape the future of coffee, not just consume it. Exhibitors represent a wide range of sectors including agrotechnology, mechanical engineering, packaging, gastronomy, logistics, and trade – a thematic diversity that sets CAFEXPO apart. The Copantl Hotel & Convention Center, one of San Pedro Sula’s premier hotels, offers spacious, modern exhibition areas alongside high-quality accommodations. Thanks to its central location, the venue is just minutes from Ramón Villeda Morales International Airport – ideal for both national and international guests seeking comfort, efficiency, and coffee excellence all in one place.

The Salon CPV, which stands for "Club of Wine Professionals," is a B2B trade show dedicated entirely to the art and culture of wine. Hosted in the luxurious setting of Le Méridien Beach Plaza in Monaco, this annual event in October attracts wine aficionados, professionals, and enthusiasts from around the globe. The event is organized by IK COM, a company not only recognized for its expertise in managing large-scale events but also for hosting wine fairs in cities like Lyon, Nantes, Monaco, Strasbourg, and Bordeaux. Focusing primarily on the regional and national terroirs of France, Salon CPV presents a unique opportunity to uncover upcoming wine trends and to engage directly with the producers. France, one of the most prestigious wine-producing countries in the world, views such fairs not just as business opportunities, but as a continuation of its rich wine culture. Central themes of the fair revolve around the discovery, tasting, and discussion of various wines. This offers attendees the chance to identify wines that might be relevant to their businesses or ventures in the future. The audience primarily consists of gastronomy and hospitality professionals, wine merchants, sommeliers, as well as representatives and buyers. A special highlight of the Salon CPV is the professional wine tastings, during which awards are given for outstanding wines. However, more than competitions and awards, it is the unique atmosphere of exchange between passionate producers and connoisseurs that distinguishes this fair. Le Méridien Beach Plaza in Monaco not only offers a stylish and welcoming setting for this event, but it also stands out due to its central location. It epitomizes the luxury and charm typical of Monaco, creating the ideal backdrop for a fair that celebrates France's exquisite wines. In conclusion, the Salon CPV in Monaco offers an impressive wine experience, representing a fusion of tradition, passion, and innovation in the world of wine.

The Parizza trade fair is an annual event that takes place in Paris and focuses on the pizza and Italian catering industry. It was created to provide professionals in the Italian cuisine field with a platform for exchanging ideas, innovations, and networking opportunities. The event attracts visitors and exhibitors from all over the world, including restaurant owners, pizza makers, ingredient and equipment suppliers, as well as representatives from franchise companies and food chains. The fair showcases new products, technologies, and services that are relevant to the industry. These include pizza ovens, dough kneading machines, refrigeration and storage systems, as well as innovative ingredients and recipes. Another highlight of the fair is the prestigious "France Pizza Championship" competition, in which talented pizza makers demonstrate their skills and compete for the title of the best pizza maker in France. The Parizza fair takes place at the Paris Expo Porte de Versailles exhibition center and usually lasts for two days. The Parizza fair takes place jointly with the Sandwich & Snack Show. The Sandwich & Snack Show is a leading European event for fast-food restaurants and out-of-home consumption. By combining the two events, visitors and exhibitors benefit from an expanded range of products, services, and innovations that are relevant to both the pizza and sandwich and snack industries.

The Snack Show ranks among Europe’s leading trade fairs for contemporary snacking concepts, quick-service dining and the out-of-home food market. Held annually at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles, it brings together the industry’s key players and provides a highly specialised marketplace for product innovation, technology and forward-looking foodservice concepts. Organised by RX France, one of the country’s foremost exhibition organisers and part of a global network of B2B event brands, the show extends well beyond a national platform. As part of an international portfolio, it attracts senior decision-makers from across Europe and further afield. Paris as the host city reinforces this global positioning. France is widely regarded as one of Europe’s most dynamic markets for bakery, snacking and chain catering, combining strong culinary heritage with a high level of innovation in foodservice. The Snack Show positions itself both as a trend barometer and as a business hub. The focus is on current developments in snacking, from plant-based and vegan concepts to gluten-free ranges, functional snacks and emerging flavour profiles. Exhibits include aperitifs, sweet snacks, ice cream and desserts, bread and baked goods, pasta, salads, sandwiches, sauces, meat and charcuterie products, dairy, frozen foods and international specialities. The offer is complemented by a comprehensive drinks segment covering tea, matcha, energy drinks, juices, natural soft drinks, syrups and lemonades. Non-food categories are equally prominent, with packaging solutions, labelling, disposable and reusable tableware, and tabletop accessories reflecting the growing importance of sustainable and functional presentation formats in the out-of-home sector. A particular draw for trade visitors is the technology and equipment segment, notably the “Smart Lab”, which showcases foodtech solutions, professional kitchen equipment, digital ordering and EPOS systems, and efficiency tools for foodservice operators, caterers and on-the-go concepts. In addition, “Parizza” provides a dedicated, closely integrated area for Italian-inspired snack and catering concepts, with a strong emphasis on pizza and pasta solutions. In this way, the show brings together several specialised segments under one roof. Exhibitors represent the food and beverage industry, packaging, catering equipment, foodtech, logistics and digital services. The event is primarily targeted at operators of quick-service restaurants, bakeries, coffee shops and chain catering businesses, as well as catering companies, hoteliers, retailers, petrol station and travel retail operators, investors and franchisors. As such, the Snack Show covers the entire out-of-home value chain. As an annual industry event, the show benefits from the modern infrastructure of the Porte de Versailles exhibition centre. The venue is directly connected to the Paris Metro and tram network and is easily accessible both from the city centre and from the international airports Charles de Gaulle and Orly. The combination of a global city, state-of-the-art exhibition facilities and a fast-growing foodservice market makes the Snack Show a key date in the calendar for anyone looking to shape the future of Europe’s snacking and quick-service sectors.

전시회명: International Bulk Wine and Spirits Show UK (IBWSS UK)
개최국: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
축제소개: The International Bulk Wine and Spirits Show UK (IBWSS UK) is a leading industry event held annually in London. Organized by the Beverage Trade Network , the show has established itself as a key platform for buyers and sellers in the global wine and spirits industry. Its primary goal is to connect producers, distilleries, importers, and distributors, fostering new business opportunities and strengthening existing networks. IBWSS UK attracts a diverse range of exhibitors – including renowned wineries, distilleries, and importers. In addition to offering products for sale, many participants also provide services such as contract manufacturing and private label programs. This allows attendees to create customized products and bring them successfully to market. The comprehensive event program covers a wide array of current topics – from trends in bulk and private label production to modern marketing strategies and global market insights. Attendees particularly value the networking events, which enable professionals to connect and forge new partnerships, as well as the practical seminars and workshops led by top industry experts. A core focus of IBWSS UK is the sourcing of bulk wine and spirits and the opportunity to build direct relationships with private label suppliers. The event offers supermarkets, retailers, restaurants, and large-scale buyers an international platform to discover exclusive products for their portfolios. The show takes place at the stunning Christ Church Spitalfields Venue – one of London’s most architecturally significant Baroque churches. Located in the vibrant and creative district of Shoreditch, the venue combines historic charm with modern amenities, providing the perfect setting for IBWSS UK. The unique atmosphere of Christ Church Spitalfields lends the event a distinctive flair and creates an inspiring environment for networking, innovation, and business success.

개최국: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
축제소개: The Speciality & Fine Food Fair (SFFF) is one of the leading trade fairs for premium food and drink specialties in the United Kingdom. Held annually in September at the prestigious ExCeL London in the heart of London, the event is organised by Montgomery International Ltd., a globally active and experienced trade show organiser. The fair is considered a must-attend event for professionals in the fine food trade, gastronomy, and high-end retail sectors. The fair serves as a platform for discovering and tasting innovative products from both the UK and abroad. It fosters meaningful dialogue among producers, buyers, retailers, importers, exporters, and hospitality professionals. The focus lies firmly on quality, authenticity, and taste – from award-winning cheeses and craft spirits to internationally recognised delicatessen products. With a clear emphasis on the evolving needs of a dynamic industry—where provenance, craftsmanship and sustainability play an increasingly vital role—the Speciality & Fine Food Fair provides targeted inspiration. Signature features such as “Pitch Live”, where emerging brands present their products to leading retailers, and the “Start-Up Village”, which showcases innovative newcomers, help bring the latest trends to light. A particular highlight is the curated education programme on the “Food for Thought” stage. Industry experts offer valuable insights into current developments, including trend forecasting, artificial intelligence in retail, ethical sustainability, gender diversity in the drinks sector, and cyber resilience. This knowledge-sharing format adds significant value beyond the product showcases. The newly designed Village Square serves as the central networking hub, offering space for regional tastings, moderated discussions, and business matchmaking. The fair experience is further enriched by immersive zones such as the Drinks Quarter, Wine Cellar and Great Taste Deli, where visitors can explore the latest flavour and consumer trends. Firmly rooted in London and the UK, the Speciality & Fine Food Fair highlights regional British specialties while simultaneously positioning the country as an international hub for fine food innovation. The historic ExCeL London, with its central location and excellent public transport links, offers ideal conditions for national and international trade visitors. For those seeking new impulses, a strong focus on quality, and opportunities to connect with thought leaders across the sector, the Speciality & Fine Food Fair remains an essential event on the industry calendar.

The Wein & More trade fair in Landshut is a small but fine, family wine fair in Lower Bavaria that focuses on the world of wines, spirits and culinary delights. The trade fair takes place in the Stadtsäle Bernlochner in Landshut, a modern and versatile event hall in the Bavarian city. It attracts numerous visitors from the region and beyond who are interested in high-quality wines, spirits and culinary delights. During the two-day event, numerous national and international exhibitors will present their products and services. It is organized by organizer Ingo Raibold, who is committed to bringing wine lovers and interested visitors together. Wein & More offers a wide range of wines, spirits, cheese, chocolate, delicatessen and other specialties from different regions and countries. The trade fair is a meeting point for winemakers, dealers, restaurateurs, sommeliers, trade visitors and wine lovers who want to exchange ideas about the latest trends, developments and innovations in the world of wine and gourmet enjoyment. In addition to the exhibition area, Wein & More offers a diverse supporting program ranging from tastings, seminars, workshops and specialist lectures to culinary shows and presentations. Experts and industry insiders share their knowledge and experiences with visitors and offer valuable information, tips and suggestions for selecting, storing and tasting wines and other products. The Wein & More in Landshut is not just a trade fair, but also a social event and therefore an ideal platform for enjoyment, information and exchange with like-minded people in a relaxed atmosphere.

개최국: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
축제소개: Foodex Manufacturing Solutions is one of the United Kingdom’s leading trade exhibitions for the food and drink manufacturing industry. Open exclusively to trade visitors, the event provides a comprehensive overview of the latest developments across the entire food production value chain, from processing and packaging through to logistics, automation and sustainable manufacturing solutions. The exhibition takes place at the National Exhibition Centre (NEC) in Birmingham, one of the UK’s largest and most advanced exhibition venues. Foodex Manufacturing Solutions is held annually and organised by William Reed Ltd., a respected British media and events company specialising in the food, beverage and hospitality sectors. Drawing on the organiser’s extensive industry expertise, the event has established itself as a key meeting place for decision-makers, manufacturers, technology providers and industry professionals. The exhibition focuses on food processing solutions, packaging technologies, intralogistics, and digital and automated production systems. Visitors can explore the latest manufacturing and process technologies, including equipment for mixing, cutting, heating and cooling food products, as well as quality assurance and hygiene management systems. The event also showcases innovative packaging machinery, sustainable packaging solutions, coding and marking technologies, and end-of-line and palletising systems. Additional areas of focus include logistics and supply chain solutions, traceability systems, and warehousing and materials handling technologies for the food industry. Emerging technologies such as robotics, artificial intelligence, Industry 4.0 applications, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and data-driven process optimisation are also strongly represented. Sustainability is another key theme, with exhibitors presenting energy-efficient production methods, resource-saving technologies, circular economy concepts and solutions designed to reduce carbon emissions throughout manufacturing and logistics operations. The exhibition covers a broad range of industry sectors, including meat processing, bakery production, dairy manufacturing, beverage production, fresh foods and seafood. Reflecting this diversity, exhibitors range from machinery and plant manufacturers to packaging specialists, automation providers, software developers, logistics companies and quality management service providers. Key visitor groups include production managers, plant and operations managers, engineers, technicians, quality managers, procurement professionals and senior executives from across the food and drink industry. The event also attracts professionals from the packaging, logistics, retail and research sectors, who attend to discover new technologies, gain insights into market trends and develop valuable business connections. Highlights of the exhibition include live demonstrations of advanced processing and packaging technologies, expert-led conference sessions and presentations showcasing innovative concepts for the factory of the future. The NEC provides a first-class exhibition environment with direct access to the UK motorway network, Birmingham International railway station and Birmingham Airport, which is located adjacent to the venue. This excellent transport infrastructure ensures that Foodex Manufacturing Solutions is easily accessible to both domestic and international visitors, providing an ideal platform for business development, networking and the exchange of forward-looking industry ideas.

Anuga Select Japan is a specialized trade fair for healthy and sustainable food and beverages, held at Tokyo Big Sight, Japan's largest exhibition center. This annual event attracts visitors and exhibitors from around the world who are interested in innovations in the food industry. The name Anuga represents a wide array of products and innovations showcased at the fair. The event aims to meet the growing demand for health-conscious and eco-friendly products, which is especially significant in East Asia where demographic shifts and climate change challenges play a central role. The main themes of the fair include delicacies, meat products, alternative protein sources, and vegan and vegetarian options. A broad range of beverages, from coffee to innovative refreshment drinks, is also presented. These reflect the global trend towards more sustainable and healthier dietary options. Anuga Select Japan serves not only as a platform for knowledge and product exchange but also as a showcase for Japan's unique contributions to food innovation. Exhibitors from various sectors, including food production and technology as well as beverage manufacturing, display their latest developments here. Visitors to the fair are professionals from the food and beverage industry, buyers from large retail chains, and representatives of organizations committed to health and sustainability. They are in search of new products that not only delight the palate but are also beneficial for health and the environment. As part of the globally recognized Anuga fairs, the event offers a comprehensive platform for the global food industry. The strikingly designed Tokyo Big Sight is located on the artificial island of Odaiba in Tokyo Bay and is easily accessible. Anuga Select Japan promises an exciting fair experience with deep insights into the future of the food industry, offering informative and inspiring moments as well as numerous networking opportunities.

UzFood is an international trade fair for food and beverages in Uzbekistan. Held annually in spring at the UEC Uzexpocentre in Tashkent, it serves as a key platform for industry professionals, companies, and experts. As the most important event of its kind in Central Asia, UzFood brings together exhibitors and visitors from various sectors, including producers, importers, exporters, retailers, restaurateurs, and food technologists. The fair is organized by Iteca Exhibitions, a company specializing in the organization of high-profile trade fairs. UzFood covers a wide spectrum of the food industry, showcasing the latest trends, products, and technologies. Key themes include food and beverages, such as meat and fish products, dairy products, baked goods, confectionery, frozen foods, and beverages. Additionally, ingredients and additives, including spices, flavors, organic products, and sweeteners, are a major focus. Another core area is food processing and packaging, featuring machinery for food production, innovative packaging solutions, and systems for labeling and quality assurance. The HoReCa sector (Hotels, Restaurants, Catering) also plays a significant role at UzFood. The fair presents professional kitchen equipment, bakery appliances, as well as coffee and tea accessories. Moreover, it highlights advancements in agricultural and agritech solutions, including modern greenhouse technologies, agricultural machinery, and innovations in seed and crop protection. A special highlight of UzFood is its live demonstrations, expert lectures, and conferences, which provide visitors with the opportunity to experience new technologies firsthand and engage with industry specialists on the latest developments. The fair plays a crucial role in advancing Uzbekistan’s food industry by fostering innovation, strengthening international business relations, and offering companies a platform to present themselves to a growing market. UzFood attracts companies from numerous sectors, including food production, gastronomy, retail, agriculture, and packaging technology. Its primary audience consists of decision-makers and professionals looking for new products, business partners, and innovative solutions. As Uzbekistan’s economic hub, Tashkent provides a modern infrastructure for trade fairs and congresses at the UEC Uzexpocentre. Conveniently located, the venue offers easy access from both the airport and the city center. This makes UzFood the ideal meeting point for businesses and experts to actively shape the future of the food and beverage industry in Uzbekistan and beyond.

WorldFood Poland is an international fair dedicated to the fields of food and beverages, food processing, and packaging. As the largest food fair in Poland, it connects traders, retailers, manufacturers, and industry associations. The annual event takes place at the Warszawskie Centrum EXPO XXI in Warsaw, known for its excellent accessibility and modern facilities. Organized by Lentewenc Sp. z o.o. Ltd., a company experienced in the organization of trade fairs, "WorldFood Poland" offers a wide range of products and services. This includes raw materials, additives, food products, and beverages, as well as packaging and logistics solutions. Special attention is given to segments such as organic foods, functional foods, dietary supplements, and plant-based meat and dairy alternatives. The fair reflects the dynamism and diversity of the food industry, both in Poland and internationally, serving as a showcase for innovations and current trends. Highlights of the program include the "WorldFood Gold Medal" competition for outstanding products and various conferences and workshops with industry experts, addressing important topics like sustainable meat production and alternative protein sources. With a broad spectrum of exhibitors from the fields of food production, beverage manufacturing, technology, as well as packaging and logistics, the fair appeals to a diverse audience. This includes producers, suppliers, retailers, and wholesalers, as well as industry specialists, emphasizing the fair's significance for trade and networking. Finally, the Warszawskie Centrum EXPO XXI in Warsaw, with its modern infrastructure and central location, provides an ideal venue. The vibrant culture and history of Warsaw further enrich the experience for fair visitors. The good transport connections and proximity to accommodations and dining facilities make the fair center an attractive meeting point for professionals from around the world.

The Bellavita Expo in Warsaw is a globally renowned trade fair dedicated to Italian food and beverages, held annually. It has established itself as a key platform for Italian producers to showcase their high-quality products to an international audience of professionals from the gastronomy, retail, and wholesale sectors. The event is organized by Bellavita Expo Ltd., a company committed to promoting Italian food and beverage culture worldwide. With a strong emphasis on authenticity and quality, the expo offers a unique opportunity to experience the richness and excellence of Italian cuisine up close. Visitors can explore a diverse range of products, from traditional specialties to innovative new offerings, including fine wines and spirits, premium cheeses, air-dried cured meats, handmade pasta, exquisite confectionery, and fresh fruits and vegetables. Italian coffee, gourmet delicacies, and convenience products also play a significant role in the exhibition. A highlight of the event is the live cooking demonstrations and tastings, where top Italian chefs showcase their skills and take guests on a culinary journey through Italy’s diverse regions. Competitions and award ceremonies add further excitement, recognizing outstanding products and innovations. The Bellavita Expo in Warsaw is exclusively open to industry professionals and serves as a central meeting point for buyers, importers, and distributors looking to expand their portfolios with premium Italian products. The fair provides an excellent platform for forging new business connections and establishing long-term trade relationships. Warsaw was strategically chosen as the venue due to its role as a dynamic commercial hub for Central and Eastern Europe. The expo is held in a modern event location that offers top-tier infrastructure and an ideal setting for business negotiations and product presentations. As part of the internationally expanding Bellavita series, which also takes place in other cities worldwide, the Bellavita Expo in Warsaw has become one of the most important industry events for Italian food and beverages. With a steadily growing number of exhibitors and visitors, it underscores its central role in the international trade of Italian delicacies year after year.

COFFeEAST is a hybrid trade and cultural fair dedicated to speciality coffee. It brings together business, craft and community in a distinctive format. The event is organised by COFFEEAST FESTIVAL SRL, a Romanian company committed to strengthening the Eastern European coffee scene, fostering connections and raising its international profile. The fair takes place at the Romexpo Exhibition Center in Bucharest, the country’s leading exhibition and convention venue. This strategic location positions COFFeEAST at the heart of South Eastern Europe – a region experiencing rapid growth in hospitality, a wave of innovative roasteries and rising demand for speciality coffee. COFFeEAST covers the entire coffee value chain. Its core focus is Eastern Europe’s speciality coffee culture – from filter and espresso traditions to third-wave roasteries, independent cafés and emerging brands. At the same time, it serves as a dedicated trade platform for professional buyers and decision-makers. Exhibitors showcase state-of-the-art roasting technology, premium espresso machines and grinders, water treatment systems, digital POS and B2B solutions, as well as accessories, ceramics and design-led products. The portfolio is complemented by craft beverages, food concepts and carefully curated lifestyle brands that broaden the overall coffee experience. A defining feature of the fair is its hands-on programme. Workshops, cuppings, sensory sessions and expert talks provide both industry professionals and ambitious coffee enthusiasts with practical insights and applicable expertise. Baristas, roasters, traders, hospitality professionals, café owners, hoteliers, importers and start-ups use the event as a platform for networking, product launches and market entry into Eastern Europe. Highlights include competitions such as the GreatEast Cup – a barista championship featuring individual and team formats alongside creative and speed challenges. The programme also includes latte art throwdowns and live performance formats that spotlight craftsmanship, precision and innovation. In this way, COFFeEAST is not only a business platform but also a stage for talent and emerging trends. The Romexpo Exhibition Center is located in the north of Bucharest and is easily accessible from both Henri Coandă International Airport and the city centre. Modern halls, generous exhibition space and robust infrastructure provide ideal conditions for exhibitors and trade visitors alike. COFFeEAST is therefore far more than a conventional trade fair. It combines marketplace, knowledge platform and festival into a cohesive, carefully curated experience where coffee culture, technology and commercial exchange converge.

The "Coffee Expo Seoul" is an international trade fair for the coffee industry, held annually at the COEX Convention and Exhibition Center in Seoul since its inception in 2012. The name underscores its significance as a central meeting point for coffee enthusiasts and professionals. As the largest coffee expo in the first half of the year, it plays a vital role in the dynamically growing coffee industry of South Korea and Asia. Organized by COEX Convention & Exhibition Ltd., a renowned entity in the field of trade fairs and conventions, Coffee Expo Seoul impresses with its diverse themes and offerings. In addition to various forms of coffee – from whole beans to green and roasted coffee – it also includes filter coffee, coffee filters, and other utensils. Moreover, numerous raw materials, ingredients, machinery, and equipment are showcased. The range extends to gourmet foods, bakery and confectionery products, as well as tea variations. Topics such as furniture and store supplies, franchising, and services, as well as paper and packaging materials, are also represented at the expo. The expo provides a unique platform for exhibitors from various sectors, including coffee producers, suppliers of bakery and tea products, and machinery and equipment providers. It attracts a wide audience, comprising dealers, restaurateurs, baristas, and other professionals from the coffee industry, as well as lovers of gourmet products and beverages. A highlight of the expo is the World Superbarista Championships, a competition that showcases the skills and creativity of the best baristas. Additionally, the expo offers seminars, workshops, and coffee tastings, granting visitors unique insights into the latest trends and innovations in the industry. The Coffee Expo Seoul reflects the increasing importance and popularity of coffee in South Korea and makes a significant contribution to the development of both local and international coffee culture. The COEX in Seoul, the largest exhibition center in Korea, also serves as a cultural and commercial hotspot. Its central location in the heart of the city, surrounded by a variety of attractions and amenities, makes it an ideal venue for international events like the Coffee Expo Seoul.

FENAVIN – the Feria Nacional del Vino – is the leading trade fair for Spanish wines and a key meeting point for industry professionals, buyers, and producers. Its name, meaning “National Wine Fair”, already reflects its core mission: the targeted promotion of Spanish wine culture. Since its inception in 2001 by the Provincial Council of Ciudad Real, FENAVIN has evolved into a strategically important event in the international wine trade. It is unique in its exclusive focus on Spanish wines, comprehensive in representing all Spanish wine-growing regions, and highly practical in its commitment to fostering business connections and supporting export activities. Each year, the Pabellón Ferial in Ciudad Real opens its doors to trade visitors from around the world. Its central location in the province of Castilla-La Mancha offers clear logistical advantages—just 50 minutes from Madrid by high-speed train—while also anchoring the fair in a region with centuries of winemaking tradition. FENAVIN centers on Spanish wine exports, the cultivation of business relationships, and the professionalization of the trade. A structured system connects exhibitors and buyers efficiently. Digital tools allow participants to schedule meetings in advance, search specifically for products or suppliers, and prepare thoroughly—an approach that enhances efficiency and delivers measurable value. At the heart of this system lies the tailor-made “Contact with...” program. Exhibitors include renowned wineries, cooperatives, trade companies, and service providers in production, packaging, and distribution—exclusively showcasing Spanish wines and wine-based beverages. The range spans from small, family-run bodegas to large-scale producers with global reach. This offer is complemented by the “Wine Gallery”, a central tasting zone where visitors can systematically compare and sample hundreds of wines, independent of the exhibition stands. A high-quality supporting program of seminars, discussion panels, and expert lectures accompanies the fair. It addresses current topics in the wine industry, emerging market trends, and legal developments—positioning FENAVIN not only as a marketplace but also as a think tank for the sector. Visitors primarily come from the national and international wholesale and retail trade, the hospitality industry, as well as from import and distribution—decision-makers with clear purchasing intent and authority. Ciudad Real, located in the heart of Spain, offers a modern exhibition center with a functional infrastructure, free parking, and excellent transport connections—whether by car or AVE high-speed train. The city itself, with its historic charm, vibrant culinary scene, and proximity to major wine regions, invites guests to enrich their visit with cultural experiences. FENAVIN is therefore far more than a trade fair—it is a window into the soul of Spanish wine.

개최국: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
축제소개: The Allergy & Free From Show in Birmingham, organised by Raccoon Media Group Ltd, is the leading event for health-conscious consumers focused on allergy-friendly lifestyles. It caters to individuals with allergies, respiratory conditions, food intolerances, eczema, or coeliac disease. Held annually at the NEC Birmingham—one of the UK’s largest and most modern exhibition centres—the event benefits from excellent transport links, spacious exhibition areas, and state-of-the-art infrastructure, offering ideal conditions for both visitors and exhibitors. The show provides a unique platform for direct interaction between visitors, manufacturers, experts, charities, and support groups. On display are allergen-free foods and beverages, skincare and haircare products, as well as household items designed to make daily life easier and improve the quality of life for those affected. A particular highlight is the diverse programme of events, including live cooking demonstrations, expert talks, and personalised advice sessions. These offer practical solutions and innovative approaches for living allergy-free.
